name: grouped-list
title: Grouped list
description: A list in date groups (Today, This week, Later, No date) or your own, with folding headings, counts, "Show N more" paging and an empty state. Pairs with selection-bar.

props.name: items
props.description: The rows, in the order they should show inside each group.

props.name: getKey
props.description: A stable key per row.

props.name: renderItem
props.type: (item: T, info: { group: GroupedListGroup; index: number }) => ReactNode
props.description: Draws one row. Render the row's content, not an <li>: the list adds that.

props.name: getDate
props.type: (item: T) => Date | string | number | null | undefined
props.description: The date a row is due, for the default date split. Rows without one go in No date.

props.name: groupBy
props.description: Your own split: return a group id from `groups`. Replaces the date split.

props.name: groups
props.description: The groups in the order they show, with their names. Required with groupBy; for the date split it renames or reorders today, week, later and none.

props.name: today
props.description: The day the date split counts from. Default the day the list first showed.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week for "This week": 0 Sunday, 1 Monday. Default 1.

props.name: pageSize
props.description: Rows shown per group before "Show more". Default 50.

props.name: moreStep
props.description: Rows each "Show more" adds. Default 100.

props.name: collapsed
props.description: Folded group ids, controlled.

props.name: defaultCollapsed
props.description: Folded group ids at first. Default none.

props.name: onCollapsedChange
props.description: Called with the folded group ids when a heading is pressed.

props.name: resetKey
props.description: Change it (a filter, a search) to set paging back to the first page.

props.name: onVisibleChange
props.description: Called with the keys of the rows on screen, in order, whenever that changes.

props.name: label
props.description: Name of the list for screen readers.

props.name: empty
props.description: Shown when there are no rows at all. Default a plain empty state.

props.name: headingLevel
props.description: Heading level of the group headings. Default 3.

props.name: stickyTop
props.description: Where the headings stick while their group scrolls, as a CSS length. Default 0.

props.name: variant
props.description: "card" draws a bordered box; "plain" sits on the page. The sticky headings take the background from `--grouped-list-bg`, so set it (`[--grouped-list-bg:var(--card)]`) when a plain list sits on a card. Default "card".

props.name: locale
props.description: BCP 47 locale for numbers and the "Until" date. Default "en".

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible and spoken text, with English defaults.

a11y.text: Each group heading holds a button that folds and unfolds the group with Enter or Space. After "Show N more", focus moves to the first new row, so the keyboard carries on where it was.

Each group is a section named by its label and count, with a real heading (headingLevel, default h3). The heading button has aria-expanded and aria-controls, and says the count as "N items" while the visible number is aria-hidden. A polite status says "N more shown" after paging.
Only the chevron turns, with a 200 ms transform. Under reduced motion it snaps. Groups open and close at once, with no height animation.

Headings are 44 px tall and stick to the top of the scroll box (stickyTop). onVisibleChange gives the keys on screen, so selection-bar can ask first when ticked rows are folded away or past "Show more".
